projectDescription: An AI-powered Claude Code skill that researches job roles, surfaces undocumented experiences through conversational discovery, and generates tailored, confidence-scored resumes from your existing resume library.
keyFeatures: Multi-job batch processing (3–5 similar jobs) with shared experience discovery
Deep company and role research via WebSearch and LinkedIn benchmarking
Branching conversational discovery to surface undocumented experiences
Confidence-scored content matching with transparent gap identification
Truth-preserving optimization — never fabricates, intelligently reframes
Multi-format output: Markdown, DOCX, PDF, and interview prep reports
Self-improving resume library that grows with each successful application
Pause/resume and incremental batch support for long job searches
publicApiSurface: SKILL.md — main skill entry point with YAML frontmatter for Claude Code
Phase 0: Library initialization (scan resumes/ directory)
Phase 1: Research (JD parsing, company research, role benchmarking, success profile synthesis)
Phase 2: Template generation (role consolidation, title reframing, bullet allocation)
Phase 2.5: Branching experience discovery (optional, conversational)
Phase 3: Content matching with confidence scoring (Direct/Transferable/Adjacent/Impact)
Phase 4: Multi-format output generation (MD, DOCX, PDF, Report)
Phase 5: Library update (conditional, user-approved)
Multi-job Phase 0: Batch intake and initialization
Multi-job Phase 1: Aggregate gap analysis with deduplication
Multi-job Phase 2: Shared experience discovery with leverage classification
Multi-job Phase 3: Per-job processing loop (interactive or express mode)
Multi-job Phase 4: Batch finalization with review options
Incremental batch addition (add jobs to completed batches)
BatchState JSON schema (_batch_state.json)
JobState JSON schema (job_id, status, current_phase, coverage, gaps)
DiscoveredExperience JSON schema (experience_id, addresses_jobs, confidence_improvement)
AggregateGaps JSON schema (critical_gaps, important_gaps, job_specific_gaps)
Matching formula: Overall = (Direct×0.4) + (Transferable×0.3) + (Adjacent×0.2) + (Impact×0.1)
research-prompts.md — JD parsing, company research, role benchmarking, success profile prompts
matching-strategies.md — scoring algorithms and content reframing strategies
branching-questions.md — technical skill, soft skill, and recent work discovery patterns
